THE SECOND HAVEN APPROACH

A home. A community.
A chance to begin again.

Second Haven is being developed as a small, nonclinical recovery residence for adults building a life in recovery. The idea is simple: a substance-free home where residents take an active role in the life they share.

Our connection to animal rescue inspired the name—a belief in patience, dignity, and second chances. That same spirit shapes the home we’re working to create.

Get to know the home

THE ROOMS & TERMS

A room of your own.
A home to share.

We’re taking inquiries for two private, unfurnished bedrooms in a three-bedroom, split-level townhome. Each room is offered for one resident, with shared common spaces.

  • Bedroom 2: 9 × 11 feet.
  • Bedroom 3: 11 × 8.5 feet.

Dimensions are owner-reported. Both bedrooms are on the lower level and require stairs. The household shares 1.5 bathrooms, including one shower.

$900 per month for either room, plus a $750 security deposit. Minimum rental term: 3 months. Utilities, electricity, washer/dryer use, and driveway parking are included. Internet availability is being confirmed. Recovery-house rules apply; JR will review the written expectations and rental terms with you before an agreement.

Available from October 2, 2026. Ask JR about the layout, access needs, viewing options, and next steps.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Questions are
always welcome.

A few things to know about the home we’re planning.

What does “peer-run” mean?+

Residents share responsibility for the daily life of the house. The planned model includes resident-elected roles, house meetings, shared chores, and mutual accountability. Property and landlord responsibilities remain with the operator.

Is Second Haven a treatment facility?+

No. The planned service is nonclinical recovery housing. It does not include detoxification, therapy, medical care, or around-the-clock staff supervision. Residents would arrange any clinical care with outside providers.

Can I inquire now, and when could I move in?+

Yes, room inquiries are welcome now. Rooms are available from October 2, 2026. Text JR at (424) 285-4489 to discuss the room, house expectations, and next steps. An inquiry does not reserve a room or confirm admission.

What does a room cost, and what is included?+

Each private, unfurnished room is $900 per month, with a $750 security deposit. Minimum rental term: 3 months. Utilities, electricity, washer/dryer use, and driveway parking are included; internet availability is being confirmed. Bathrooms and common areas are shared. Written rental terms will be reviewed before any agreement or payment. Financial assistance is not currently confirmed.

What are the rooms and access like?+

Bedroom 2 is 9 × 11 feet and Bedroom 3 is 11 × 8.5 feet, according to the owner. Each is offered as a private bedroom for one resident. Both are on the lower level, reached by stairs. The household shares 1.5 bathrooms with one shower. Discuss any access needs with JR.

Where is the house, and can I visit?+

The home is at 2192 4th Avenue East, West Fargo, ND 58078. Contact JR before visiting to discuss viewing options.

How can I make a housing inquiry for someone?+

Call or text JR at (424) 285-4489 for general room and referral questions. Please keep an initial inquiry to contact details, room interest, and timing; do not send medical records by text. Rooms are available from October 2, 2026. JR will discuss current availability and the next steps directly.
